question:
The perimeter of a circular garden is 506 m. The cost (in ₹) of levelling it at ₹14/m² is:

(Take pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 2πr = 506

⇒ 2 x 22 over 7 x r = 506 ⇒ r = 161/2

The cost for levelling the ground = πr² x 14 = 

⇒ (22)/(7) times (161)/(2) times (161)/(2) times 14 = Rs. 2,85,131

**∴ The cost for levelling the ground is Rs. 2,85,131**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Perimeter of circular garden = 506 m

Cost of levelling = 14/m²

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of circle = 2πr

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of circle = 2πr = 506

⇒ 2 x 22 over 7 x r = 506 

⇒ r = 161/2 m

The cost for levelling the ground = Area of circle x 14

⇒ πr² x 14

⇒ (22)/(7) times (161)/(2) times (161)/(2) times 14

⇒ Rs. 2,85,131

∴ The cost for levelling the ground is Rs. 2,85,131.
